cards.hint: työ (work) is hiding right at the front of työskennellä
"a-VAT-a" — pry the lid off the vat to open it
"sulk-ea" — you close up and sulk
"aloha!" is how every hello starts — a-lo-ittaa (alku = the beginning)
loppu = the end, and lopettaa lops off the end
as in "Hyvää jatkoa!" (have a good continuation) — jatkaa = to continue
"ur-it-tah" ≈ "earn it" — try hard and you'll earn it
onni (luck / happiness) + -stua = to succeed, happily
epä- (un-) + onnistua (to succeed) = un-succeed = to fail
valmis (ready) → valmistaa = to make ready
"see-vo-ta" ≈ "sieve it" — sieve out the dirt to clean
"kor-ya-ta" ≈ "correct-a" — correct it, fix it
"wreck-o" — wreck it to break it (rikki = broken)
"rack-en-tah" — rack up the bricks to build (rakennus = a building)
sounds like "mutate" — mutate = change (also what you do when you move house)
"lö-tää" ≈ "lost-a" — you found what was lost
"et-see-ah" ≈ Etsy — you search on Etsy
"kite-tah" — take the kite out and use it (käyttäjä = a user)
tarv- ≈ starv- — when you're starving, you need food (tarve = a need)
"val-ee-ta" ≈ "valid" — choose the valid one (valinta = a choice)
